Results The study included 53 eyes of 44 patients. Fourteen eyes (13 patients) received S-CXI, treatment (26%), while 39 eyes (34 patients) received A-CXL treatment (74%). The mean age of the patients was 15.4 years in the S-CXI. group and 14.9 years in the A-CXL group. Fifty percent of the S-CXL group and 59% of the A-CXL group were males.
